scope: Cross-domain WIC reasoning, contradictory evidence, multiple simultaneous faults, evidence precedence, next-check selection and confidence boundaries.
principles: Start from conditions/symptoms, not component replacement.
One symptom may support several causes; one cause may produce symptoms across several domains.
Direct/localized evidence outranks broad pattern evidence for naming a root cause.
Contradictory evidence reduces or blocks a hypothesis; it must never be silently discarded.
Multiple independently localized faults may coexist and must not be collapsed into one diagnosis.
Operating-state invalidity can veto otherwise plausible steady-state interpretations.
A completed check is evidence and must not be recommended again.
Choose the next check for discrimination: prefer a practical check that best separates the remaining plausible causes.
Specific diagnosis requires sufficient positive/localized evidence and no unresolved contradiction that materially undermines it.
When evidence is insufficient, report the supported system condition and the best next check rather than invent specificity.

evidence_precedence.type: equipment/model-specific direct test or manufacturer diagnostic result
localized physical/electrical evidence at suspected component
cross-domain measurement pattern with applicable references

cross_domain_families.policy: walk from room/load and airflow through refrigeration/feed, high side, compressor and controls before sizing unless direct evidence localizes sooner
state gate first; low suction alone cannot diagnose low charge

candidate_domains: flash gas/lack of liquid at TXV
cross_domain_families.policy: establish starvation condition, then discriminate root cause with liquid condition, localized restriction and TXV evidence
safety trip is consequence; localize heat-rejection/charge/control cause
ice is a condition; identify pattern and failed sequence/local evidence
do not condemn compressor from temperature/protection alone
establish commanded sequence and reason for each stop/start before assigning fault

decision_policy.specific_root_cause: requires direct/localized or equipment-specific evidence; broad correlated symptoms alone are insufficient
decision_policy.system_condition: may be reported from a coherent pattern even when root cause remains unresolved
decision_policy.possible_causes: retain only causes compatible with known configuration/state and not materially contradicted
decision_policy.multiple_faults: report each independently supported localized fault; also report interaction when one fault can amplify another
decision_policy.next_check: exclude completed checks; prefer safe/practical high-discrimination check among unresolved hypotheses; respect physical access and system state
decision_policy.unknown_reference: show measured value but do not classify low/normal/high
decision_policy.conflict: surface conflict and request resolving check; do not average contradictory evidence into false certainty
